chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said at the end of a long hadith, in which he describes the ghusl (ritual bath) of the deceased:

key_terms.آخِرِ: the end or concluding part of the narration
key_terms.تُخَلِّلْ: to interlace-clean or work between parts, here meaning cleaning beneath or between the nails

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on cleaning under the fingernails of the deceased during ghusl?
ai.summary: This narration gives a specific legal instruction concerning the ghusl (ritual bath) of the deceased. It indicates that the fingernails of the deceased are not to be cleaned by interlacing or digging beneath them during the washing.
